function: Designs RIS sensing vectors, downlink RIS reflection coefficients and AP beamformer power allocations from received pilots for multiuser beam tracking (pp. 1, 7).
system: MU-MISO, AP with 8 antennas (ULA), passive reflecting RIS with 100 elements (10x10), 3 single-antenna UEs, 1 GHz carrier, 10 MHz bandwidth (pp. 3, 8).
method: LSTM recurrent network plus graph neural network, trained offline, unsupervised, maximizing the average minimum user rate over 20 concatenated frames with Adam (pp. 7, 9).
data_channel: Custom simulator for training and testing: Rayleigh direct link, Rician (factor 10) RIS links, Gauss-Markov temporal correlation 0.9995, random UE trajectories at 10 m/s (pp. 8-9).
test_conditions: Trained on sequences of 20 frames; tested over hundreds of frames with the same channel model; L, M, Nr are swept without stating retraining (pp. 9, 11).
baselines: Non-learned: BCD with perfect CSI, random RIS with perfect CSI. Learned: GNN with fixed sensing [24]; GNN and LSTM without active sensing [6], [18], [24]; ablations (pp. 9-10).
metrics: Average minimum user rate (bps/Hz) per frame and block, relative to the perfect-CSI BCD benchmark; array responses and SINR maps for interpretation (pp. 10-13).
complexity: Inference order O(Kd^2+Kdη+(K+NrL)κ+(K+2)^2ςD), hidden size 512; no runtime or FLOPs reported (pp. 9, 12).
q1_support: p. 9: "modeled by the Rayleigh fading" and "follow the Rician fading model" in a custom Gauss-Markov simulator; no 3GPP, DeepMIMO, or measured data is mentioned.
q2_support: p. 11: "maintains its performance for transmission frames beyond 20, despite being trained with only 20 concatenated active sensing units"; only a longer tracking horizon, same channel model.
q3_support: p. 9: "BCD With Perfect CSI [3]"; p. 10: "GNN With Fixed Sensing Scheme [24]"; both are compared with the proposed method on the minimum user rate in Fig. 9.
q4_support: p. 12: "the total computational complexity for the proposed active sensing unit during the inference stage" is given as O(Kd^2+Kdη+(K+NrL)κ+(K+2)^2ςD).
q5_support: p. 1: "The source code for the numerical results in this paper is available on-line at https://github.com/HanHanCoding/MUTracking-ActiveSensing".
notes: Included, area 3. q1=0: the path-loss laws 32+43.3log(l) and 28+16.9log(l) are custom (p. 9). q2=1 rests only on the horizon (hundreds of frames versus 20 in training, p. 11) with the same channel model; the L, M, Nr sweeps (pp. 11-12) do not state retraining and are not counted. Reviewer to confirm. q3: [24] is an earlier paper of the same authors; BCD with perfect CSI is the non-learned benchmark.
